name: Liar Liar 2
source: The story continues one year after [url=https://vndb.org/v15274]the previous game[/url] left off. Yukari and Miho are now high schoolers, who are now dating and spend their leisure time together holding hands, kissing, and murdering the occasional boy or two. On one particular day that was just like any other, a new transfer student arrives to Yukari’s school. It’s Koshi Tanaka! But wasn't he dead? Apparently not. The goal of the game is to figure out the mysterious circumstances of Tanaka’s revival and most importantly, staying alive.
translation: 故事接续[url=https://vndb.org/v15274]前作[/url]一年后的剧情。由香和美穗如今是高中生，两人成为恋人，闲暇时牵手、接吻，偶尔还会杀掉一两个男孩。在又一个平常的日子里，一名转学生来到由香的学校。他就是田中浩志！但他不是已经死了吗？似乎并没有。游戏目标是弄清田中复活的神秘原因，更重要的是活下去。
